name: Sliding leg curl
instructions: Lie on your back on a smooth floor with your heels on a towel or in socks.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are almost straight.
Pull your heels back toward your hips, keeping the hips high.
cue: Hips high, drag the heels in
mistakes: Letting the hips drop as the legs straighten.
